filing.eventDescription: One delivered filing snapshot ($3 per 1,000 rows; row keys id, cik, company, accession_number, form, filing_date, report_date, accepted_at, items, content_hash, fetched_at). No start fee; proxy and compute included. Filters, duplicates, excluded rows and failures without delivered rows are free. Stops at maxTotalChargeUsd (Apify run option, not input). Nested data included; partial errors retain paid rows already delivered. Inspect free SUMMARY for page limits and source errors.
